feedback_text: I started a claim but stopped at the paperwork step because I could not work out which forms applied to my case.
It would help to see the required paperwork before starting the claim instead of discovering each item one screen at a time.
I called only to ask which receipt format is accepted. The requirement itself should be clearer online.
The upload reached 100%, then the page returned to the empty upload box. I do not know if the file stayed attached.
The claim still shows 'documents required' even though I uploaded the requested form yesterday.
I need to correct the treatment date before submitting, but the review screen sends me back to the beginning.
The submit button produced no response, and I cannot tell whether a claim was created.
The form accepted a future treatment date without warning me. I noticed it only on the review screen.
My email says the claim was approved, while the app still shows it under review.
The claim disappeared from the tracker after I updated my phone. Support later confirmed it still exists.
I asked support for an update because the tracker had not changed for more than a week.
I received a partial reimbursement but cannot see how the amount was calculated.
I am disappointed by the amount, but the calculation is clearly explained and there is no processing problem.
The currency shown on the payment summary is wrong, although the deposited amount is correct.
Face ID stopped working after the update. I can still sign in with my password.
The sign-in screen keeps refreshing, so I cannot reach my claims.
The password rules appear only after submission. Please show them while I am creating the password.
It is annoying to sign in again, but I was able to continue immediately and nothing was lost.
I can access the website with my details, but the mobile app says the account does not exist.
I waited 25 minutes, then the call disconnected before anyone answered.
I received different answers from two representatives about whether another form was required.
The support agent was helpful; the only inconvenience was navigating through several menu options first.
My connection dropped on the final step. When I reopened the app, the draft and attachments were still there.
The instructions are clear overall, but the difference between service date and invoice date could be explained better.
The claim was resolved quickly, but the status notification arrived a day after I saw the change in the app.
